g.text: Single 360-min tissue (NASA R-value model): tissue N₂ relaxes exponentially towards the inspired N₂ pressure; R = tissue N₂ / suit pressure. Initial tissue N₂ = 0.79 × 101.3 kPa.
Real protocols were validated in chamber trials; exercise during prebreathe, not modelled here, speeds nitrogen removal.
